title: Low-Dose Streptozotocin Induction Protocol for Mice
author: Frank Brosius
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8izhuf6
materials: Prepare the buffers and solutions as described below. Please note that the STZNa-Citrate solution should be prepared immediately prior to injection so as to avoid degradation of the STZ.

steps.title: Fast mice before injection
steps.instruction: Fast each mouse for approximately four hours prior to the STZ injection.

steps.title: Anesthetize mouse with isoflurane
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in an isoflurane drop jar (follow local IACUC anesthesia standards) and wait until breathing slows and the animal is fully anesthetized. Reload isoflurane after every third or fourth mouse.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse in isoflurane drop jar.
Observe breathing; remove mouse when breathing has slowed and anesthesia is achieved.

steps.title: Inject STZ intraperitoneally
steps.instruction: Inject the appropriate volume of streptozotocin (STZ) solution intraperitoneally so that each mouse receives a final dose of 50 mg per kilogram body weight.

steps.title: Recover mouse and return to cage
steps.instruction: Allow the mouse to awaken from anesthesia and then place it back into its home cage.

steps.title: Repeat injection series for each mouse
steps.instruction: Perform the anesthesia‑inject‑recover sequence for every mouse, giving one injection per day for five consecutive days.

substeps.instruction: Administer one injection per day for five consecutive days.

steps.title: Provide sucrose water if needed
steps.instruction: Supply mice with 10 % sucrose‑containing drinking water, if necessary, to prevent sudden hypoglycemia after STZ injection.

steps.title: Assess hyperglycemia and re‑treat if required
steps.instruction: Test mice for sufficient hyperglycemia four weeks after the injection series. If any mouse is not adequately diabetic, re‑administer the low‑dose STZ protocol to that mouse only at week seven post‑injection.

substeps.instruction: Measure blood glucose at 4 weeks post‑injection.
If glucose levels are not hyperglycemic, repeat the low‑dose STZ injection at week 7 for the affected mouse(s).
